title: High Court Urged to Intervene in High-Stakes Surrogacy Dispute Over Fetal Life
snippet: A surrogate mother who defied an abortion request from intended parents has elevated her legal battle to the U.S. Supreme Court, bringing complex ethical and contractual questions to the national stage.
content:
WASHINGTON — A fierce legal battle over parental rights, bodily autonomy, and contract enforcement has reached the U.S. Supreme Court after a surrogate mother refused a request from intended parents to terminate her pregnancy.

A Clash of Contracts and Rights

The dispute arose after medical screenings indicated potential health complications with the fetus, prompting the intended parents to request a abortion pursuant to the terms outlined in their gestational surrogacy agreement. The surrogate, citing deeply held moral convictions, refused to follow the directive, triggering a rapid series of emergency legal challenges in lower courts.

As the petition reaches the nation's highest tribunal, legal scholars emphasize that the outcome could establish far-reaching precedents concerning the enforceability of medical decisions within surrogacy contracts versus a surrogate's constitutional bodily rights.
